title: Evaluate genuinely unseen biological data
intro: Evaluate models with grouped cross-validation, class-aware metrics, honest calibration diagnostics, and a final group-safe project.

scientific_context.caution: All subject groups and labels are synthetic. Three-fold CV on six simulated animals is only a method demonstration; it does not provide reliable biological accuracy or calibrated probabilities.

chapter_method: Predict → Run → Investigate → Apply → independent Prove → delayed review.

goals.title: Run group-disjoint cross-validation
goals.why: The same biological animal cannot contribute fields to both training and validation folds.
explain: GroupKFold partitions all fields of a subject together. Each fold must have zero overlapping animal IDs.
Ordinary KFold randomizes fields, not biological animals, and can overestimate new-animal performance.
All numerical examples are synthetic. Cross-validation outputs alone do not validate prediction on new biological preparations.

Low Brier score on eight synthetic samples does not prove calibration or transfer to other acquisition batches.
All numerical examples are synthetic. Cross-validation outputs alone do not validate prediction on new biological preparations.
